compiled: Compiled from wire reports filed 24–25 Nov 2026, as of 05:00 UTC

edition: The World Today — One Image Edition

lead.deck: A Long March-2F rocket lifted off from Jiuquan at 00:18 UTC carrying three astronauts to the Tiangong station — commander Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi, and Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, 40, the first Pakistani in orbit and the first foreign astronaut ever to visit Tiangong. Ali will spend up to ten days in orbit on joint biotech experiments.
lead.headline: Pakistan Reaches Orbit as China Launches Shenzhou-24
